actualUI.result: Cold restore initially showed fallback icons as expected without a disk cache. Visiting the owned declared-icon page populated all three same-origin tabs, including a sleeping restored tab and another live tab; bookmark bar and overflow showed the blue icon.
From a new tab with the address editor focused and empty, clicking the ordinary bookmark immediately displayed the navigated fixture URL and focused HTML without needing Esc.

From an unfinished address draft, clicking the ordinary bookmark replaced the draft with the actual fixture URL and returned HTML focus. Tab icons, bookmark icons and readable overflow labels were observed.

evidenceLimits: Actual UI used the final product behavior of build 29; subsequent changes only added smoke failure diagnostics. These diagnostics are not invoked by normal QA startup.
Owned HTTP fixture declared PNG returned 200 while its default favicon.ico returned 404, proving the observed bookmark icon was reused from the declared icon path.

NSCache may discard entries, but no memory-pressure reproduction proved the historical transient failure. An isolated old-cache capacity probe retained 128 entries and evicted the expected oldest one; it did not reproduce that failure.
Three final passing smoke runs do not establish the cause or resolution of the two inspector focus failures. Keep this regression concern open.
No actual overflow pointer opening/right-editing, real IME/VoiceOver, additional extension compatibility, system-version, audio, Codex paste, receiver attachment or performance acceptance is implied.
Normal installed app and prepared capture clipboard unchanged; owned manual QA and fixture-server sessions stopped; 0.8 remains an unreleased alpha.
